Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Both sides converge on the same arithmetic, and so do I. The trip is TRP-02825; the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02825) shows charged_total SGD 26.73 on a METERED rate card. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02825) measures 18.2 km driven against the booked optimal of 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02825), an excess of 4.2 km — 30.0% of optimal. That clears both of POL-RD-01's establishment gates (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km absolute), so a deviation is ESTABLISHED. It does not reach the material gate (over 50% or over 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06's FULL_REFUND uplift and its conduct referral are not engaged; and no repeat pattern can be built anyway, because driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against a threshold of 3 and 1 flag over 162 completed_trips_90d is 0.006 against a threshold of 0.05 (POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01 — the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only and was not used). The driver's counterparty statement, 'Navigation rerouted me', is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else; no advisory covers this corridor (EV-ADVIS-02825-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0) and no advisory identifier was cited, so under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight and the deviation stands at the measured 4.2 km. No rider instruction exists (EV-CHAT-02825 holds 0 messages), so POL-RD-04 cannot run, and no amendment was recorded (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null), so POL-RD-05 never opens. The vehicle was RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is irrelevant, and the fare is METERED with no quoted fare, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-refund route. The remedy is arithmetic, not discretionary: under POL-RD-02, recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 14.0 km + 0.28 x 19.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02825) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = SGD 20.42. charged_total is SGD 26.73. Refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = SGD 6.31, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 6.35. That is 23.6% of charged_total — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35. Stated on separate lines: charged_total 26.73, recomputed_fare 20.42, refund 6.35. No pass-through correction is added on top: the EV-FARE-02825 ledger itemises 0 ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge, and a trip that ends rather than originates at an airport attracts none (POL-RD-09). The rider was not billed for less distance than the trace records, so no driver compensation arises under POL-RD-04. On evidence weight: EV-GPS-02825 is schema-impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a 40.0 s sampling gap, 0.4 km apart, from 14:00:32 to 14:01:12). Measured against POL-RD-07 it is NOT impaired for policy purposes — the gap is under the 90 s limb (a), the jump under the 500 m limb (b), and the 10 s sampling interval under the 30 s limb (c) — so it is down-weighted in confidence under POL-GEN-02 alone and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. The excess fact is carried by that trace at 0.85; the trip_record's actual_distance_km is, under POL-RD-01, a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and not an independent carrier, so my confidence is capped at 0.85 — above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate. The rider's profile adds no corroboration requirement (deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, POL-RD-08). The monetary effect of SGD 6.35 is within the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes on issue.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 6.35 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
